# Glorious High-Tech School Examination Portal

- Use Next.js App Router, TypeScript, React, Tailwind CSS, and Supabase.
- Treat Supabase Row Level Security and trusted database functions as authoritative. Never expose service-role secrets to the browser.
- Never send answer correctness flags to student clients. Grade server-side.
- Keep Class 10 Boys and Class 10 Girls as distinct student/result/ranking groups even when they share an exam paper.
- Avoid demo student records, credentials or production claims. Browser monitoring cannot guarantee prevention of screenshots or external activity.
- Review database migrations and RLS policy changes before applying to any existing school project.
